200.description: Recognition decision (upstream TRQP recognition response plus the optional Verana breadcrumb).

message.description: Present on out-of-scope denials (`out of v4 recognition scope (corporation → ecosystem only)`) or session-scoped denials (`session not found`).

verana.description: Verana-specific breadcrumb for the controlling relationship. Present when authority_id controls entity_id; omitted otherwise.

400.description: Malformed request (invalid action, resource grammar, or context.time).
